messages:
Ben (Sales): Hey CS — passing Hyperloop AI to you. Contract signed; go-live target 2024-04-15. Scope: private VPC deployment, Dedicated tier (2xA100 reserved), Okta SSO, and streaming generation. Biggest risk is launch-day burst traffic from a marketing campaign. Primary customer contact: Maria Chen (maria@hyperloop.ai). Please confirm owners for provisioning, SSO, and perf soak.

Ana (CS): Thanks Ben — picking this up. Can someone from infra/eng confirm timelines for provisioning and perf validation? Also want a short enablement session with Hyperloop product team the week before launch.

Ravi (Support): I'll own support-side onboarding and handoff to eng for any infra tickets. Plan: create a triage runbook and a 24/72h on-call escalation rota for launch week.

Jasmine (Eng): FYI — for Dedicated + VPC we need subnet details and a signed infra access form. Also streaming will need KV cache tuning; we'll want to test 5k concurrent sessions. ETA for a baseline cluster: 7 business days after infra approvals.

Ben (Sales): Maria is available to share infra details this week. She said security team needs an MSA appendix for SOC2 scoping. I'll attach contacts.

Ana (CS): Action items so far: 
• Ana -> run preflight checklist & kickoff call by 2024-03-25.
• Ravi -> create support runbook + escalation rota by 2024-03-28.
• Jasmine -> infra provisioning ticket + perf load test plan (target 5k conc) by 2024-03-29.
• Ben -> send subnet details, security contact, and signed MSA appendix by EOD tomorrow.

Jasmine (Eng): Creating ENG-4642 for provisioning. Notes in ticket: need CIDR block, firewall rules, and Okta metadata. Quick snippet for infra team to apply: ```bash
# apply VPC peering & routing
terraform apply -var='cluster=hyperloop-ai-dedicated'
```

Ravi (Support): Putting onboarding checklist in Airtable and linking to ENG-4642. Will also add a playbook section: "If 5xx rate increases >2x during ramp -> throttle + fallback model variant."

Ana (CS): Planning a 30-min enablement session with Hyperloop PMs to cover routing, SLAs, and escalation paths. Proposed time: 2024-04-08 10:00 PT. Ben — can you confirm?

Ben (Sales): Confirmed, sending calendar invite to Maria, security lead, and product. 

onboarding-bot: Reminder: add SSO metadata to the secure doc vault and grant read to "eng-oncall" before provisioning.

Jasmine (Eng): Noted. Also flagging a perf risk: streaming latency currently ~220ms P95 on staging; with Dedicated and kernel optimizations we expect ~120-150ms. Need to validate after quantization profile applied.

Ana (CS): Recording ownership: Ana (CS) overall owner; Jasmine (Eng) infra/perf owner; Ravi (Support) support/runbook owner. Next sync: 2024-03-22 09:00 PT to validate infra request completeness.

Ben (Sales): Thanks team — pinging Maria now for subnet + Okta details. I'll update thread once I hear back. :thumbsup:

Ravi (Support): I'll scaffold the emergency runbook and post a draft by EOD.

Jasmine (Eng): Will start the cluster provisioning plan and post ENG-4642 checklist updates.

Ana (CS): Great — filing handoff note into the account bundle. Leaving this thread open for updates; please tag @Ana (CS) for any blockers. :white_check_mark:
